definition: Applies substantial offensive pressure to break defensive Pokemon or defensive cores; more specific than merely having damaging moves.
Uses self-boosting setup to threaten a sweep or a sequence of knockouts; not every use of a boosting move establishes this role.
Finishes weakened opponents or cleans late in a game, as described for this set.
Removes offensive threats after a teammate falls or after a free entry; includes an explicitly described revenge-killing role.
Provides strategically described speed control through Choice Scarf, priority, speed-altering support or similar means; an EV speed benchmark alone is insufficient.
Combines offensive pressure with a switching move or explicit momentum-generation role to bring teammates in.
Uses defensive switching capability and pivoting or sustained recovery to bring teammates in safely.
Is described as a dedicated or broad physical wall, rather than only checking one named physical threat.
Is described as a dedicated or broad special wall, rather than only checking one named special threat.
Provides an explicitly described defensive check or switch-in to a limited set of threats; this is not a universal counter claim.
Sets entry hazards as a described contribution of this set or one of its listed variants.
Removes entry hazards from its side as a described role of this set.
Blocks or deters the opponent's hazard removal, for example through spinblocking or blocking Defog, as a described contribution.
Uses status infliction to cripple opponents as a described contribution; merely having a move with a secondary chance is insufficient.
Heals or cures teammates, such as Wish passing or Healing Wish support; self-recovery alone does not qualify.
Establishes weather to support a team strategy, not merely benefits from weather set by a teammate.
Establishes terrain to support a team strategy, not merely benefits from a teammate's terrain.
Establishes Reflect, Light Screen or Aurora Veil as team support.
Breaks or disrupts defensive/stall strategies through explicitly described denial, disruption or sustained pressure, beyond generic damage alone.
Uses forced switching to displace opponents, deny setup or accumulate hazard damage as a described role.
Prevents or deters opposing entry-hazard setup, for example with explicitly described Magic Bounce or Taunt use; distinct from removing existing hazards or preserving allied hazards.
